page_title: Folders — The Windows Explorer alternative for macOS

sources.entry: Folders File Manager - A file manager with an expandable folder tree, similar to that of Windows Explorer.

summary.name: Folders
summary.one_liner: Folders is a macOS file manager with a persistent expandable folder tree, modeled on Windows Explorer, sold in a free-trial, one-time-purchase Pro edition and a sandboxed App Store edition.
use_cases: replace Finder with a Windows-style folder tree on a Mac
browse and manage cloud storage services in one tree
batch rename many files at once
browse and edit archives without extracting
mount and browse network shares over SMB, NFS or WebDAV
browse iOS device filesystems over USB (Pro edition)
summary.what_it_does: Folders shows drives, network shares, cloud services, tags, recents and favorites in one persistent folder tree on the left, with files in a pane on the right. It offers Table, List, Icons and Gallery views, Quick Look preview, and folder-level view settings. Its file operations include cut with Cmd+X, conflict resolution with an option to merge folders, multi-step undo, and Batch Rename. It can display and edit zip, 7z, tar, gz and other archives in the tree, and connects to SMB, NFS, WebDAV, FTP, FTPS, SFTP and S3-compatible servers. The Pro edition adds Git status, iOS device browsing, shell and AppleScript actions, and command-line launch.
notable: Single-pane folder tree modeled on Windows Explorer
Folders Pro is unsandboxed with Git support, iOS device browsing and custom Actions
Archive browsing and editing directly in the tree
Native Swift app, universal binary for Intel and Apple silicon
caveats: Fully functional 14-day trial, after which a one-time purchase is needed; pricing amounts are on a separate Pricing page and not stated here
App Store edition is sandboxed and needs the user to grant access to folders such as the main drive
